chapter_title: Concerning the Sect of the Basket
spiritual_reading:
The whole ordered system of life in which you now exist is a formed structure of perception and operation, and you are like an effect still held in living connection with that structure. If you had already been separated from that system by a prepared receiving and gathering of uses, then you could rightly claim a new origin from that gathered use itself. But if you are still bound into the general order and draw your state from it, how can you ascribe your origin to what only receives at the end, before you have been separated into it as a completed use? For so long as an effect remains in immediate dependence on its producing structure, it is not yet to be named a gift of charity in act. Likewise you, while you remain entangled in the general order and not yet gathered into a distinct use, are not properly to be called one whose origin is from that receiving of charity.

There are interior and superior governing principles, and a ruling understanding that gives form and direction, together with an initiating vigor in the first affection for truth and good, attended by complete arrangements of ministering intelligences. There are also subordinate arrangements of ministering intelligences that serve the higher ones, yet something in their order here resists full determination from the text. There are stable supports of order that hold the whole in its standing, and a surrounding expanse of general knowledges in outermosts encompassing the system. There are universal guardians distributed through the whole extent, sustaining power in the lowest degree, which is the natural plane upon which all higher degrees rest. There are additional derivative ruling tendencies proceeding from the primal spiritual human, by which the system is held in firmness, and there is the calling forth of influx and the responsive submission of lower things to higher government.

In a third domain, also in a lower degree, there is a full organized set of operative forces fixed in place. Yet the description of their representative forms is broken and cannot be wholly recovered. Still, there are three chief supports of power by which stability is given; and there are three other chief means by which that stability is extended into what is outermost and perceptible. These outermost means are the external truths by which living influx is clothed for action at the time when it descends. Something is said of their being cast forth together with what is displayed within them, but the precise action is unclear from the damaged text; it appears to treat of external truths being arranged so that interior things may be manifested in them.

What follows speaks of an orderly completeness established before a great governing function that admits and regulates entrance into a higher state. In its power are three chief agencies set for resistance against what is disorderly, and these are present among people as active protections. Whoever recognizes their governance and commits the inmost of life to their keeping is preserved by the order they maintain, though the concluding details are uncertain where the text is missing.

fills.notes: The series begins with the highest interior principle before “great …” and “great Mind”; in the oldest cosmological register this is the primal source, not a personal savior-frame. “Father” fits the impersonal Zoroastrian-Manichaean substrate triad (Father, Greatness, Mind) as governing origin.

Corresponds to the ‘superior governing principle’ and the standard oldest-layer designation paired with “great Mind.” It is the magnitude of the First Principle, the plenitude that contains the ordered powers.

The spiritual translation points to “a ruling understanding that gives form and direction.” The oldest-layer idiom prefers an abstract function over later hagiographic titles; “first Understanding” matches that function and pairs naturally with “great Mind.”
The clause needs the copular link: “the great Mind that is with this Youth …”. The Youth is the initiating vigor/first affection, attendant upon Mind.
Restores the governing noetic principle explicitly named in the paragraph’s opening triad.
The Youth is described as ‘with’ the Mind and attended by ministering orders; “standing” preserves the static cosmological descriptiveness of the oldest layer rather than dialogic action.
Connects the two angelic enumerations as coordinated ministering orders under the higher set.
The break “but … of the twenty-two …” suggests a subset within the 22. In the substrate register these are ‘chiefs’ or ‘heads’ of an order rather than ecclesial offices.
The seven pillars must be described as fixed/standing in the central axis of the cosmos. “stand in the midst” matches the correspondential idea of stable supports of order at the center.
Links “seven pillars …” to “the sea that surrounds the universe …” as two structural features (axis and circumambient expanse).
Introduces the next distribution: the four angels assigned through the extent of the universe.
“distributed to the … universe” calls for a totalizing term; the spiritual translation says “distributed through the whole extent.”
“supporting the mightiness … below” points to the lowest degree, the natural plane; “world below” is the substrate way to denote the earth-plane under the heavens.
Connects the supporting function to the identification of the lowest as “the earth of all the heavens.”

“the universe is stood firm … the summons and the obedience …” needs the concept that firmness comes from ordered responsiveness of lower to higher. “Order” supplies the governing cosmological principle.
Gives the causal bridge: the cosmos stands firm ‘by’ the summons and the obedience (influx and response).

The third domain is explicitly said to be ‘below’; the twelve powers ‘standing firm there’ correspond to fixed operative forces in the natural degree. “In the earth” matches “below, which is the earth of all the heavens.”
Links the placement of the third domain to the enumeration of the twelve powers.

The spiritual translation notes that the description of the representative forms ‘is broken and cannot be wholly recovered.’ This lacuna is exactly that editorial notice in the oldest-layer voice: the account of the images is broken.
The three pillars ‘of mightiness’ are fixed supports; “are set there” keeps the static architectural register.
“pillars supporting the disk …” in the lowest degree points to the earth-disk, the outermost perceptible plane. This matches the correspondential ‘outermost and perceptible.’
Balances the prior triad: three great pillars of mightiness, and ‘the other three great pillars’ as the next set extending stability outward.
The spiritual translation identifies these ‘other three’ as ‘external truths by which living influx is clothed for action.’ Naming them “of truth” keeps the oldest layer impersonal and functional.
Instead of later devotional phrasing, the substrate speaks of influx being clothed in ultimates. “garments that the Living Spirit clothed himself in” matches that correspondential mechanism.
Temporal connector needed: “he put them at that time when …”
Matches the spiritual translation’s “at the time when it descends,” i.e., living influx taking outer forms.

“that threw them, together with … which is displayed therein” implies what is cast forth are forms that manifest interior things. “the forms” supplies the object without importing later polemical terms.
Corresponds directly to “what is displayed within them” and the idea that interior realities are manifested in external truths.
“this … perfect before … great Porter …” calls for a term of ordered completeness/structure established. “arrangement” preserves the impersonal cosmological register.
Grammatical support before “great Porter.”
Connects: “great Porter … in his power …” i.e., the Porter as regulating function.
Introduces the triad of resisting agencies as established in the Porter’s power.
The resisting agencies are functional protections, not persons in a devotional frame; “powers” matches the chapter’s own terminology (twelve powers) and keeps register consistent.
The opposition is against what is disorderly; the oldest substrate speaks in terms of order versus disorder rather than moralizing sin-language here.

assessment: Most small lacunae can be restored by the chapter’s architectural-correspondential scheme: triads of interior principles, numbered ministering orders, structural supports (pillars, sea), and the law of influx-and-response (“summons and obedience”). Larger gaps remain underdetermined in exact proper names and some numeric sub-order detail (especially around the 22 angels), but the demanded functions are clear enough to restore in the oldest, impersonal cosmological register.
